claims.text: The department administers marriage registration under HMA and SMA, so the first workflow decision is legal route and ceremony status rather than an assumed one-size-fits-all form.
claims.notes: No couple facts or category was supplied.

claims.text: HMA section 8 provides for entering particulars of a Hindu marriage in a register under prescribed state conditions; current Karnataka application fields and documents were not exposed in this public pass.
claims.notes: Do not infer a completed registration.

claims.text: SMA solemnization starts with written notice to the district Marriage Officer after at least one party has resided there for at least thirty days; publication/objections precede declaration, solemnization and certificate. The Act separately covers registration of marriages celebrated in other forms.
claims.jurisdiction: India; Karnataka administration by Marriage Officer/SRO
claims.notes: No notice, objection, appointment or ceremony was initiated.

claims.text: The official department report records Kaveri-2.0 implementation and the public landing URL is a workflow entry lead; this pass did not establish live availability of a specific Bengaluru SRO/category or whether all downstream steps are online.
claims.notes: No login, OTP, form, upload, payment, appointment or submission.

claims.text: Current Bengaluru SRO/Marriage Officer, fee, document checklist, witness/original requirements, appointment availability, processing time and certificate outcome remain Unknown.
